justification.dataset: DANDI 000056 (Peyrache ADn) is the canonical head-direction ring-attractor dataset, exactly appropriate for the phenomenon.
justification.handling: Real NWB files streamed via remfile, HD computed from dual LEDs with -1 sentinels masked, states and wake-restricted unit selection all handled correctly.
justification.analysis: MVL with an occupancy-matched resampling null, Bayesian decoding, circular angular-speed with a time-bin-shuffle control, and label-permutation corr-of-corr nulls are all correct circular methods.
justification.correctness: Every headline number reproduces from run.log, but the README states the HD-cell yield inconsistently as both 52/147 and 53/147 (code sums to 53/148), a minor benign inconsistency.
justification.figures: Figures show all HD cells (not flattering subsets), clear wake tracking, preserved correlation matrices, and a full five-session replication panel; only a cosmetic colorbar-label overlap in fig5.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and the weakest session (NREM r=0.47, p=0.045) is reported in the range rather than hidden, but there is no explicit limitations section for an otherwise clean result.
justification.verdict: A correct, thorough, reproducible five-session replication of the head-direction ring attractor that I would accept and move on from.
